speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long you have had these symptoms? Also, have you noticed any similar symptoms on the soles of your feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pets, particularly cats or dogs, and have you noticed if the rash worsens at night? I also need to check if you have any hair loss on the scalp or eyebrows.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed description. I would like to examine the rash more closely to look for burrows between your fingers and on your wrists. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of close contact with cattle or buffalo, and have you noticed any scaling on the soles of your feet? I also want to know if the itching is more intense at night.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation as a rice farmer, the presence of hypopigmented macules, and significant eyebrow thinning, I suspect a parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin scraping for Sarcoptes scabiei mites

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative scabies test rules out that common cause, so I need to consider your livestock exposure. Have you had direct skin contact with cattle or buffalo, and do you notice any annular, scaly lesions on your extremities?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your exposure to livestock, the eyebrow thinning, and the negative scabies test, I suspect cutaneous leishmaniasis or a similar zoonotic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy for histopathology and PCR for Leishmania

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin biopsy shows chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy. PCR for Leishmania is negative.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results are highly suggestive of leprosy, which aligns with your livestock exposure and specific symptoms like eyebrow thinning. To confirm the diagnosis, I need to check for nerve involvement and acid-fast bacilli. REQUEST TEST: Nerve conduction studies and slit-skin smear for acid-fast bacilli

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Nerve conduction studies show reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves. Slit-skin smear for acid-fast bacilli: Negative.

speaker: Doctor
text: The nerve conduction study confirms peripheral neuropathy, which strongly supports leprosy despite the negative smear, likely indicating a paucibacillary form. DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)
